about.title: About QR Studio
about.subtitle: A local-first QR toolkit for creating, batching and scanning codes.
about.built: Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No framework, no backend, no external services.
about.featureGenerateDesc: URL, text, Wi-Fi, email, phone, SMS, vCard and location payloads with validation.
about.featureDesignDesc: Colors, gradients, dot and corner styles, center logos, PNG, SVG and JPG export.
about.featureBatchDesc: Up to 1,000 codes from pasted lines or CSV, validated and delivered as a ZIP.
about.featureScanDesc: Camera scanning with torch support, plus local image decoding.
about.featureLibraryDesc: Search, filter, sort, preview, download and edit up to 100 recent codes.
about.featurePrivacyDesc: No accounts, no analytics, no tracking and no content ever sent to a server.
about.privacyBody: QR Studio runs entirely in your browser. QR content, logos and history are stored in your own browser using LocalStorage and IndexedDB. They are never transmitted. The app makes no analytics or tracking requests.

limitations.local: Data is tied to this browser and device. Clearing browser data deletes your QR codes.
limitations.camera: Camera scanning requires HTTPS or localhost and a browser that supports getUserMedia.
limitations.barcode: Some browsers lack the BarcodeDetector API; QR Studio then falls back to the bundled jsQR decoder.
limitations.batch: Batch output does not include center logos, keeping ZIP generation fast and small.
limitations.wifi: QR readers differ in how they handle Wi-Fi and vCard payloads. Test with your target scanner.
limitations.history: History keeps the latest 100 codes; favorites keep up to 1,000.
limitations.pwa: Offline use requires one successful online visit so the app shell can be cached.
limitations.svg: SVG logos are sanitized; complex effects may render differently in some scanners.

about.creditsBody: Open-source libraries are bundled locally for offline use. No external CDNs are used at runtime.
about.license: Full license texts are included in the lib/ directory.

shortcuts.search: Focus search in History and Favorites

about.offlineBody: QR Studio is a progressive web app. After the first visit it works offline and can be installed from your browser's install option.
about.made: Designed and built as a local-first web app.
about.noWarranty: Provided as-is, without warranty. Always test QR codes before printing at scale.
